item.title: We tasked Opus 4.6 using agent teams to build a C Compiler
item.description:
📝 Running multiple Claude agents allows for specialization. My implementation of parallel Claude is bare-bones. Lessons from programming with Claude agent teamsThe scaffolding runs Claude in a loop, but that loop is only useful if Claude can tell how to make progress.

item.title: LinkedIn checks for 2953 browser extensions
item.description:
📝 LinkedIn Chrome Extension Fingerprinting LinkedIn silently probes for 2,953 Chrome extensions on every page load. js Fetches extension names from Chrome Web Store with Extpose fallback for removed/unavailable extensions. # Fetch all extensions node fetch_extension_names.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/mdp/linkedin-extension-fingerprinting

item.title: My AI Adoption Journey

item.title: A small, shared skill library by builders, for builders. (human and agent)
item.description:
📝 This repo includes skills from me and my friends. me/ Installation pnpx skills add PsiACE/skills --skill='*' Or install globally: pnpx skills add PsiACE/skills --skill='*' -g Skills Skill Description friendly-python Practical guidance for writing, refactoring, and reviewing friendly Python code piglet Practical Python craftsmanship guidance based on One Python Craftsman fast-rust Practical guidance for writing, refactoring, and reviewing fast, reliable, and maintainable Rust code Documentation Install doc dependencies with uv and preview locally: uv sync --group docs uv run mkdocs serve -f mkdocs. yml Build the static site: uv run mkdocs build -f mkdocs.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/PsiACE/skills

item.title: Hypernetworks: Neural Networks for Hierarchical Data
item.description:
📝 Hierarchical data reminds us that it isn’t. Standard neural nets fail badly in this setting. Train a single model across all datasets and it will blur across differences, averaging functions that shouldn’t be averaged.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.sturdystatistics.com/posts/hnet_part_I/
